training.subtitle: Training
training.description: Company primarily provide training in Python, Qt/Qml, OpenGL, Design Patterns and Linux Device Driver. 50% is lecture whereas 50% is lab session with average participant of 15.
data: Machine Learning training course is of 40hrs. It mainly covers Supervised and Unsupervised classification.

OpenGL training is of 24 hrs. It mainly covers drawing privitives, viewing, color & lighting, Blending, Antializing, For, Polygon Offset, Display List & Pixel Operation, Texture mapping, framebuffer, Tessallotors & Quadrics, Evaluator
Python training course is of 40hrs. It covers variables, modules, class & Objects, Inheritance & Polymorphism and Exceptions.
C training course is of 24 hrs. It covers basic types, functions, control statement, pointer & array, structure and gdb debugging.

C++ training course is of 40hrs. It mainly covers sequential & associative containers, statement & expression, references, class, interitance, polymorphism, iterator, templates, generic programming, namespaces, C++14.
Linux Internals training is of 40 hrs. It mainly covers Memory management, processes, Multi Threading, IPC and File Systems
LDD Training is of 40hrs. It main covers linux kernel, building & running modules, character devices, concurrency & race condition, meory management, block drivers, network drivers.
Qml training course is of 24hrs. It mainly covers Qt Properties, QML Building blocks, User Input, Qt Quick classes, Composing UIs, C++ integration and Dynamic creation of items.
Design Patterns training course is of 32hrs. It mainly covers C++ Object Model and Vtable structure. GOF Creational, Structural and Behavioural Design Patterns.
Qt training course is of 40hrs. It mainly covers modules core, widgets, gui, network, modelview, graphicsviews, database, 2dpainting and Qml.
Kivy training course is of 24hrs. It mainly covers 3D OpenGL graphics.
Artificial Intelligence training course is of 40hrs. It mainly covers Mutli Agent scenario
